headword: {自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}

definitions.explanation: The field of computer science and AI concerned with getting computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language. Covers tasks such as translation, summarization, and sentiment analysis.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}を{研究|けんきゅう}する。
{翻訳|ほんやく}アプリは{自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Translation apps use natural language processing technology.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、{自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}は{深層|しんそう}{学習|がくしゅう}によって{大|おお}きく{進歩|しんぽ}した。
examples.english: In recent years, natural language processing has advanced greatly thanks to deep learning.

notes:
Combines {自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご} (natural language, i.e. human language) with {処理|しょり} (processing). The AI and computer-science field dealing with human language. Often abbreviated NLP.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: NLP technology
- {自然|しぜん}{言語|げんご}{処理|しょり}モデル: an NLP model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {深層|しんそう}{学習|がくしゅう}: deep learning — the machine-learning approach that now powers most NLP
- {機械|きかい}{学習|がくしゅう}: machine learning — the broader field NLP draws on
